## What's New

### 5 New Skills (46 Total)

Expanded the skills library with high-demand specializations:

- **`ui-ux-designer`** - Design systems, user research, wireframing, design-to-code workflows
- **`database-architect`** - Data modeling, query optimization, scalability patterns, PostgreSQL expertise
- **`api-designer`** - REST/GraphQL API design, versioning strategies, OpenAPI documentation
- **`technical-writer`** - Documentation, API docs, ADRs, runbooks, tutorials
- **`test-automation-engineer`** - E2E automation with Playwright/Cypress, CI/CD test pipelines

### New Design Category

Added a dedicated `design/` subcategory under developer-specializations for UI/UX skills.

### Documentation

Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/`:
- **Quick Start Guide** - Get running in 5 minutes
- **Skills Catalog** - Complete reference of all 46 skills
- **Examples**:
  - Building a SaaS App - Full project walkthrough
  - API Design Workflow - Multi-skill API design

### CI/CD Improvements

- npm OIDC trusted publishing (no classic tokens needed)
- Improved GitHub Actions workflows

## Stats

- **46 skills** across 6 categories
- **14 agent definitions**
- **184 tests** passing
- Cross-platform support (OpenCode + Claude Code)

## Full Changelog

https://github.com/SwiggitySwerve/locus-product-planning/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md

## What's New

### Claude Code Support 🎉
Cross-platform session hooks for automatic skill bootstrap:
- `hooks/session-start.sh` for Unix/macOS
- `hooks/session-start.cmd` for Windows
- Automatic skill loading on session start

### Enhanced Skill Discovery
- **`use_skill`** tool - Load skills by name with namespace support (`locus:`, `project:`)
- **`find_skills`** tool - Filter by category, tier, and search term
- **`find_agents`** tool - List available agent definitions

### New Commands
- `/locus-skills` - List available skills with optional filtering
- `/locus-skill <name>` - Load a specific skill
- `/locus-agents` - List available agents

### Skills Core Library
Extracted reusable utilities (`src/lib/skills-core.ts`):
- Support for nested YAML metadata objects
- Three-tier skill resolution (project > personal > locus)
- Robust Windows line ending handling

### Plugin Metadata
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` for Claude marketplace
- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` for discoverability

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Windows line endings in YAML frontmatter parsing (#2)

## Stats
- **184 tests** ensuring reliability
- **40+ skills** across 5 categories
- **14 agent definitions** for specialized perspectives
